title: Systems of Linear Equations
preview: Solve systems of two linear equations by graphing, and determine whether a system has one, no, or infinitely many solutions.
description: Students solve systems of linear equations by graphing, interpret the intersection point in context, and determine the number of solutions from the graphs (one intersection, parallel lines, or the same line).

sections.label: 5-1 Solve Systems of Equations by Graphing
sections.description: Find the intersection point of two lines graphically and interpret it in context.

sections.label: 5-2 Determine Number of Solutions
sections.description: Classify a system as having one solution, no solution, or infinitely many from the graphs.

source.name: Plug N Play
